newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Nov 1-15 palm oil exports 298,862t - SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Nov 1-15 palm oil exports 298,862t - SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor, Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd said on Friday it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for November 1-15 at 298,862 tonnes compared with 374,988 tonnes for October 1-15.
It said the exports comprised 68,322 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 121,320 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 39,750 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products accounted for 69,470 tonnes.
SGS said China was the top buyer during the period, taking 55,900 tonnes followed by India which bought 37,167 tonnes, Egypt (28,000 tonnes) and U.S. (24,942 tonnes).
Countries in the European Union bought 23,300 tonnes while Middle East countries took 17,320 tonnes, it said.
